description: turbo-tasks: take_effects reads and captures the effects on up to one spawned worker per core (available_parallelism), each taking the next effect not yet taken from a shared counter and each within the calling task's execution (spawn_in_current_task, as in 75), and puts the results back in the effects' order; 75 spawned one task per effect. Test: as 75's, two captures that each hold their thread until both have arrived both meet
